title: Process-diverse E3/P4 qualification on the active-drainage MAP09 real-SWAP carrier
question: Does the qualified stencil-internal multiscale physical-tangent estimator remain available and does P4 converge when the real-SWAP prescribed-head corrector includes the frozen MAP09 active-drainage process configuration, across materially different live MODFLOW response classes?

carrier.note: Both frozen starts were participant-status 0 in MAP09.

tangent_E3_MAP.readiness: participant status 0; raw result_status 0; completed and candidate_ready
tangent_E3_MAP.central: h-d and h+d must be ready and share one execution class; center class is irrelevant
tangent_E3_MAP.backward: h, h-d and h-2d must be ready and share one execution class
tangent_E3_MAP.forward: h, h+d and h+2d must be ready and share one execution class
tangent_E3_MAP.multiscale_gate: Return the coarser member of the first adjacent candidate-scale pair whose slopes differ by <=5% relative to the larger magnitude.

map09a_crosscheck.note: This is a local crosscheck against qualified MAP09A whole-window bottom-outward exchange sensitivity, not an assumption that active drainage contributes a nonzero J_nonbottom.

nonbottom_measurement.method: At the E3-selected href scale, evaluate corrector mass diagnostics at the two samples defining the selected finite-difference stencil where a symmetric central pair exists; compute J_S, J_R and J_nonbottom=J_S+J_R. If E3 selects one-sided at href, record decomposition as NOT_SYMMETRIC rather than inventing a pair.
nonbottom_measurement.acceptance: finite/mass-complete only; no requirement that J_nonbottom be nonzero

rule: For each regime first solve one fresh constant-flux MODFLOW probe at q=q_swap(href) with zero head bias.
Set the frozen-for-that-regime head bias to href minus the returned MODFLOW head. This is a deterministic translation calibration, not an adaptive convergence tune.
With that bias, remeasure all five fixed q=q_ref+offset probes and fit q_gw(H)=aH+b.
Require a>0 and max affine fit error <=1e-16 m/s.

policies.P1_E3_MAP: Raw physical Newton using E3_MAP re-estimated at each iterate.
policies.P4_E3_MAP: Same E3_MAP proposal with unchanged factor-1/2 backtracking until participant status is 0 and |q_swap-q_gw_fit| does not increase.

required_gates: MAP09 predictor identity, active-drainage coverage, reference corrector and immutable origin reproduce.
E3_MAP is AVAILABLE at href and both frozen +/-1e-6 starts with <=5% adjacent-scale agreement.
Href E3_MAP slope agrees with the qualified MAP09A J_R/dt crosscheck within 1%.
Groundwater calibration and local affine-oracle gates pass independently for all three regimes.
P4 converges from both frozen starts in all three regimes; P1 outcome is recorded.
No participant probe, rejected policy candidate, or raw diagnostic changes committed revision/time/ledger authority.
interpretation: PASS would extend E3/P4 research evidence from the drainage-free B1/B4 family to the frozen active-drainage MAP09 corrector process configuration.
PASS does not prove a nonzero drainage contribution to dq/dH; J_nonbottom is measured rather than assumed.
PASS does not constitute production admission or justify changing production HCOF/RHS.
After G12, remaining production-preparation gates are estimator/corrector cost and an explicit production integration/ownership contract.
